entries.text: Put away your phones. It is time to begin class.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_01

entries.text: While you’re out performing fieldwork with one\nof your Pokémon walking alongside you...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_02

entries.text: have you ever noticed changes in its coloration?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_03

entries.text: Now I don’t mean that it suddenly becomes a\nShiny Pokémon or any nonsense like that.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_04

entries.text: I am speaking of it becoming filthy![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_05

entries.text: Pokémon battle! They get hurt by moves used\nagainst them![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_06

entries.text: They get battered by wind and rain! They get\ncovered in sand and mud![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_07

entries.text: They get, in a word, filthy![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_08

entries.text: I have seen many a Trainer walking about with\ntheir adorable little Pokémon without addressing\r\nthis issue. It is deplorable.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_09

entries.text: Let me ask this question of someone who I am\nsure would not tolerate such shameful conduct.\r\nAh yes, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_10

entries.text: What should you do if your Pokémon is dirty?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_11

entries.text: Clean it up
entries.label: class_g_06_select_01

entries.text: Pat it on the head
entries.label: class_g_06_select_02

entries.text: Nothing
entries.label: class_g_06_select_03

entries.text: Perfectly correct! I knew I could count on you to\nprovide me with such an answer.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_answer_01

entries.text:
While patting your Pokémon on the head to
express appreciation for its hard work would
make for an adorable moment, that would not
clean it of its filth![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_answer_02

entries.text: I suppose, in time, filth accumulated from rain\nand mud may well fall of its own accord...but I\r\nnever expected such an answer from you.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_answer_03

entries.text: When your Pokémon are dirty, clean them!\nThis is, of course, simply common sense.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_12

entries.text: While you are having a picnic, you can approach\nthe Pokémon on your team and perform a\r\nvariety of actions.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_13

entries.text: One such action is putting them through what I\nlike to call the “Pokémon Wash”... In other words,\r\nyou are able to clean them up![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_14

entries.text: You start by getting your sponge lathered up with\nsoapy bubbles as you gently and carefully scrub\r\nyour Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_15

entries.text: Once your Pokémon is nice and covered in\nsoapy bubbles...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_16

entries.text: the bubbles will encapsulate the filth, then you\nsimply wash it away with a spray of water![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_17

entries.text: This will get your Pokémon clean and shining\nbright as a Tera Jewel![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_18

entries.text: It is certainly quite a bit of work, but this will\nalso restore HP and cure status conditions.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_19

entries.text:
However, some Pokémon may have parts of their
bodies that they don’t want scrubbed or that
they would rather not get wet.\c
Be sure to keep this in mind when cleaning your
Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_20

entries.text: Now, the most important point that I must\nmention is that some Pokémon LIKE to be dirty.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_21

entries.text: Though I will contradict myself by saying this,\nplease do remember that cleaning your Pokémon\r\nis not always the kind thing to do.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_22

entries.text: Our time together has come to an end for today.\nI bid you all farewell.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_06_home_23
